content: Ecarhuma barhabâla
Rhulonzize okummumanyîsa, bene wîrhu, enshôkano Nyamuzinda àshobôzize Ekleziya z’e Macedoniya.
Omu malibuko manji babwîne, obushagaluke bwâbo bunene n’obukenyi bwâbo bunji byayunjulirîne, byahinduka buhirhi bwa kurhabâla abandi.
Nk’oku banali bahashire, niene mpanyire obwo buhamîrize, ciru na kurhalusa obuhashe bwâbo bwône,
bayish’irhuyinginga mpu rhubashobôze nabo enshôkano y’okushangîra ogwo mukolo gw’okurhabâla abatagatîfu
Balushîriza ciru aha rhwàli rhulangâlire là! Barhag’ijà aho, bacîhâna bône emwa Nyakasane, okubundi bacîhâna emwîrhu oku bulonza bwa Nnâmahanga.
Rhwanacihûna Tito obwo, nti obwôla ali amârho­ndêra ogwo mukolo gw’okurhabâlana aguyunjulize emwinyu.
Ci kulya mulushana muli byoshi: omu buyêmêre n’omu kumany’iderha, n’omu buzigire rhwammuyigîrizagya, ntyo kwo munalushanage na mw’okwo kurhabâla abandi.
Lirhali irhegeko mmuhîre ene nderha ntyo; ci kuderha nti mbè nkanarhangula erhi obuzigire bwinyu bunali bo omu kushîbirira abandi.
Murhahabiri enshôkano ya Nyakasane Yezu Kristu, oku ye wali mugale acîjiraga mukenyi mwe murhumire, mpu lyo obukenyi bwâge bummujira bahirhi.
Ihano kwône mmuhîre mw’okwo; okwôla kwo kunamukwânîne mwe mwarhondêraga ogo mukolo kurhenga mwâka injo. Arhanali kurhondêra okugujira kwône, ci n’okugulonza.
Nêci, ogwo mukolo muguyujuzagye, na ntyo kulyâla mwâli mubiduhire omu kulalira, kwo munashubig’ibiduha n’omu kujira, nk’oku munahashire.
Obulonza bukabiduha, eci omuntu agwêrhe co cinarhuma asîmwa, ci arhankadôsibwa eci arhagwêrhi.
Ntadesiri nti mukûle abandi olukoba emumiro, mucîhiremwolo, ci nti muyumanyanye.
Mw’okûla rhuli buno, ebimmulugîre birhabâle obukenyi bw’abinyu, lyo ebibalugîre nabo biyish’irhabâla obukenyi bw’abinyu, na ntyo muyumanyanye,
nka kulya biyandisirwe, mpu
: Owali orhôzire binji birhamulugiraga, n’owali orhôzire, binyi birhamunyihiraga.
Entumwa Paolo ali arhumire e Korinti
Mushâna Nyamuzinda ayâgirwe! owahiraga obu bushiru kuli mwe omu murhima gwa Tito.
Ayumvîrhe izù lyâni. Ciru abà bushiru kulusha, ayishire emwinyu oku kulonza kwâge yêne.
Rhumurhumîre bo na mwene wîrhu muguma, olya irenge lyâge omu kulumîza Emyanzi y’Akalembe
liderhwa omu Ekleziya zoshi.
Arhanali kwône okwo: acîshozirwe n’Ekleziya mpu anyôse rhukaz’ibalama rhwe naye mw’ogûla mukolo gw’enshôkano rhwacîhânyirekwo, lyo Nyakasane ajà irenge, lyo n’omurhima gwîrhu gurhûlûla.
Kulonza okwôla nti harhag’ijira owarhutumuza kw’ogûla mwandu gw’ebirugu barhubarhuzize.
Bulyâla rhulonza okujira aminjà, arhali omu masù ga Nyamuzinda mwône, ci n’embere z’abantu.
Rhubarhumîre bo n’olya mwene wîrhu
warhuyêresire kanji kanji oku anabà mukombêdu, na buno acîyêrekîne wa bushiru kulusha bulya acimmwîkubagire bwenêne.
Tito yêhe ye wîrhu rhubà rhwe naye, ye nantabâla oku mukolo ekarhî kinyu. Abandi bene wîrhu, Ekleziya zibarhumire, bali irenge lya Kristu.
Embere z’Ekleziya mubayêreke oku obuzigire bwinyu bunali bo, n’oku obwîkubagire rhummugwêrhemwo burhali bwa busha.
